rows.title: Inside the Atom
rows.subtitle: What everything is made of
rows.description: Start with the smallest pieces of matter. See what atoms are made of, what makes one element different from another, and why some nuclei are stable and others are not.
rows.goal: Describe the structure of an atom, tell elements and isotopes apart, and explain in plain words why some nuclei change.

guidebook.summary: Everything you can touch is made of atoms. Each atom has a tiny nucleus of protons and neutrons with electrons around it. The number of protons decides the element. Atoms of one element can differ in neutrons: those are isotopes. Some nuclei are stable; others are unstable and change, giving off radiation.
